# Buceo Sur Gran Canaria

> Family-run scuba diving centre in Playa de Arinaga, Gran Canaria, Spain. Officially
> licensed by the Government of the Canary Islands. Offers guided dives for certified
> divers, discover-diving baptisms for beginners, PADI/SSI/CMAS certification courses,
> and sidemount diving courses, in Spanish, English, French and German.

## Pages

- [Home](https://buceosur-gc.com/): centre overview, team, facilities, location.
- [Dives](https://buceosur-gc.com/dives/): guided dives for certified divers.
- [Discover diving / Baptisms](https://buceosur-gc.com/baptisms/): first-dive experiences for beginners, no certification required.
- [Courses](https://buceosur-gc.com/courses/): PADI, SSI and CMAS certification courses.
- [Sidemount](https://buceosur-gc.com/sidemount/): sidemount configuration courses.
- [Rates](https://buceosur-gc.com/rates/): pricing for all activities.
- [Gallery](https://buceosur-gc.com/gallery/): underwater and facility photos/video.
- [Contact](https://buceosur-gc.com/contact/): address, phone, email, contact form.

Content is also available under the `/en/`, `/fr/` and `/de/` locale prefixes (Spanish
is the default, unprefixed locale).
